description: This source file manages team momentum mechanics in the game, including momentum modification, decay, and event notifications related to team actions such as building, destroying, and killing players.

methods.name: MomentumTypeToReason
methods.description: Converts a momentum type enum to a descriptive string.

methods.name: MomentumChanged
methods.description: Updates client momentum display and checks team progress after momentum change.

methods.name: NotifyLegacyStageSensors
methods.description: Notifies legacy sensors about team momentum stages based on current momentum.

methods.name: MomentumTimeMod
methods.description: Calculates a time-based modifier for momentum rewards.

methods.name: MomentumPlayerCountMod
methods.description: Calculates a player count-based modifier for momentum rewards.

methods.name: MomentumMod
methods.description: Calculates the overall momentum reward modifier based on action type, time, and player count.

methods.name: AddMomentum
methods.description: Adds momentum to a team, optionally notifying the source and triggering events.

methods.name: G_DecreaseMomentum
methods.description: Exponentially decreases team momentum over time.

methods.name: G_AddMomentumGeneric
methods.description: Adds generic momentum to a team.

methods.name: G_AddMomentumGenericStep
methods.description: Adds a step of generic momentum, to be finalized with G_AddMomentumEnd.

methods.name: G_PredictMomentumForBuilding
methods.description: Predicts the momentum reward for building a specific buildable entity.

methods.name: G_AddMomentumForBuilding
methods.description: Adds momentum reward for constructing a buildable.

methods.name: G_RemoveMomentumForDecon
methods.description: Removes momentum when deconstructing a buildable.

methods.name: G_AddMomentumForDestroyingStep
methods.description: Adds momentum for destroying a buildable, to be finalized with G_AddMomentumEnd.

methods.name: G_AddMomentumForKillingStep
methods.description: Adds momentum for killing a player, to be finalized with G_AddMomentumEnd.

methods.name: G_AddMomentumEnd
methods.description: Finalizes momentum changes and triggers updates.
